name: sparx — Illustrator Portfolio
tagline: A loud, work-wall portfolio for an illustrator.
description: A personality-first portfolio for an illustrator: a loud two-tone hero, a dense playful work wall of tiled pieces that tilt on hover, a warm “hi, I’m me” band, and case-study pages that walk the brief, the making and where it ran. The palette IS the brand — warm riso-cream carried by a coral primary and a cobalt accent, expressive Syne display. Shipped as Pilar Ortega.
